Synopsis

The Oguni Campus Fellows live simple but fulfilling lives, thriving on plantations and blacksmithing. Despite their poverty, the people remain hopeful and content in their tight-knit community. However, the peace of their small country is under threat as a looming war of invasion begins to brew. Amelia, the mighty kingdom of war and magic, has been expanding its territory under the rule of Queen Amelia, a powerful monarch who commands an army of wizards with her supernatural abilities. As the kingdom's reach grows, the peaceful life in Oguni becomes increasingly uncertain. Will the Fellows' resilience be enough to face the storm on the horizon?
